passage:
Cub and Pup are buds. 
Cub and Pup have lots of fun. 
Cub runs in the sun. 
Pup digs in the mud.

Cub and Pup are hot and wet. 
The fun must stop. 
Cub and Pup must get in the tub.

The buds have fun in the suds. 
The fun did not stop!
